title: Sliding-horizon reservoir sampler for per-domain calibration micro-packs
creator: Ava Morales
description: Design and implement a production-worthy sampling strategy to generate compact, domain-scoped calibration micro-packs for FP8/INT8 quantization validation. The sampler should prioritize recent traffic, surfaced failure examples, and semantic diversity while enforcing a hard pack-size budget. Output format and metadata must support automated accuracy validation runs and incremental rollouts.
acceptance_criteria: Sampler produces a consistent newline-delimited JSON (ndjson) micro-pack per domain with metadata fields: domain, fingerprint, token_count, timestamp, source_id, rolling_score
Per-domain packs meet size budget targets: default 2000 examples (configurable) and can be downsampled deterministically for small-budget testbeds
Sampling weights combine recency, failure signal, and semantic diversity with tunable coefficients; default weights documented and applied in code
End-to-end validation job can run on CI and produce metrics CSV with per-domain accuracy deltas for FP8/INT8 vs FP16
Integration tests added: deterministic seeding, LSH bucket stability, and no regressions on representative domains from production (search-help, billing, content-moderation)
Runbook for pack regeneration and TTL-based eviction documented in Confluence and linked from the code repo
decisions: Use locality-sensitive hashing (SimHash) for lightweight semantic bucketing instead of full clustering to reduce compute cost at ingestion

Adopt a sliding-horizon reservoir that keeps a hard cap per-domain and favors recent examples via exponential recency weighting (alpha = 0.6, beta = 0.25, gamma = 0.15 for recency/failure/diversity by default)
Pack TTL set to 14 days by default; packs regenerated daily with deterministic seed to allow reproducible CI runs
Pack format will be ndjson with top-level metadata and per-example fingerprint to allow incremental diffing and caching
next_steps: Merge sampling library prototype PR and tag v0.1 (assigned to @lchen)

Run a 48-hour synthesis job on staging traffic to generate baseline packs for 12 domains (search, billing, docs, moderation, chat-support, onboarding, analytics, integrations, payments, translation, summarization, legal)
Wire pack outputs into the quant-eval CI pipeline and run FP16 vs INT8 and FP8 passes for Llama-3-70B and Llama-2-13B variants
Collect and publish per-domain accuracy deltas and failure-case examples to the evaluation dashboard

implementation_notes: Sampler design: maintain per-domain reservoir capped at N; incoming examples get LSH fingerprint -> bucket -> candidate weight computed; replacement policy is weighted reservoir sampling with exponential recency multiplier

Weight formula (string): weight = exp( lambda * recency_seconds ) * (1 + failure_signal_score) * diversity_boost; default coefficients: lambda=1.2e-6, failure_signal_score scaled [0,2], diversity_boost in [0.5,1.5]
Storage: packs written to GCS and mirrored to a short-lived cache in Redis for fast access during CI; filenames include deterministic seed and timestamp
Metrics emitted: per-example origin tag (live/replay), rolling_score, LSH_bucket_id, and whether example preserved KV-prefix
Determinism: all sampling runs use SHA256-based seed derived from day and domain to allow exact reproduction of pack contents for audits
